messages:
marta: heads up — deploy-bot flagged a values mergeconflict during canary deploy for payments-service (canary=10%). seeing inconsistent replica counts between eu and us overlays.

deploy-bot: automated-detect: values-merge-conflict (payments-service/1.12.0-canary) - blocking canary progression. details: overlay/us/replicas=3 vs overlay/eu/replicas=1. see /deploy/logs/3501234567. :warning:

sam: copying logs —
```
# helm diff
- overlay/us.replicas: 3
+ overlay/eu.replicas: 1
```

jen: ah that explains CPU spike in eu-canary pods earlier, they were scaled down then spiked because HPA target hit.

sre-oncall: what does canary health look like? any 5xx or crashloops?

marta: eu canary: 2/3 pods ready, one in CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled in sidecar. no 5xx from traffic route (we routed only 10% via route). logs show init script failing on cert fetch.

sam: if overlay mismatch is the root, we should either patch eu overlay to replicas=3 or pin the chart to previous stable where overlays were consistent. which is faster?

release-lead: timeline — region promotions scheduled in next 30m. i'd prefer hotpatch replica count for EU + re-run canary. avoid full rollback unless necessary.

jen: agree hotpatch if we can ensure cert fetch fix isn't tied to image change. quick check: image tag unchanged from stable, only values changed. so hotpatch replicas is low risk.

marta: ok i can push a hotpatch values override to set overlay/eu.replicas=3 and restart canary pod. command i'll run: `helm upgrade payments-service ./chart --set overlay.eu.replicas=3 --reuse-values --namespace prod-eu --wait`

sre-oncall: add temporary traffic spike guard — set canary to 5% until we confirm stability. also keep autoscaler paused for EU to avoid flapping.

deploy-bot: action queued: hotpatch-request by marta. preflight checks: image-digest-match=ok, schema-validate=ok, quota=ok.

marta: applying now.

(2m later)

marta: hotpatch applied. helm returned success. EU canary pods restarted.

jen: watching metrics — EU pod ready -> 3/3. no OOMs. request latency normal. CPU stable. :thumbsup:

release-lead: do we want to continue canary at 10% or hold at 5% until tomorrow? Also need release notes entry for the values fix.

sam: keep at 5% for another 30m, then promote if no regressions. I'll create a short release-note: "Fix overlay replica mismatch causing EU canary pod instability; hotpatch applied to align replicas with US overlay."

marta: noted. I'll also open a small PR to the values repo to revert the accidental eu override that set replicas=1. link coming.

deploy-bot: canary progression unblocked. monitoring policy: extend canary window +30m.

release-lead: decision recorded: hotpatch + short hold at 5% -> no rollback. create followup ticket for values repo cleanup and add pre-merge CI check for overlay replica diffs. @jen @sam please add to release checklist. :white_check_mark:

sam: adding checklist items now.

jen: filing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/values/merge/1234. summary in PR: remove accidental eu-replicas override.

marta: thanks all. i'm going to update release notes and mark this thread for post-mortem notes.

sre-oncall: closing loop — will watch for 30m and escalate if anything pops up.

(30m later)

deploy-bot: canary window complete, no regressions observed. canary promoted to 100% and chart pinned to 1.12.0 for release notes.

release-lead: promotion done. creating final release notes and tagging release engineers.

marta: thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
